what: NDT-SCAN-W (2026-10-17): the forward's verdict on its activations taken by their writers. bcir_tensor_rms_scan_pool, bcir_tensor_silu_mul_scan_pool (and _v2) and bcir_tensor_attention_scan_pool (and _v2) compute their plain entries' values bit for bit and set a verdict when one of their regions holds an element that is not finite after the call, read back by the tasks that wrote them (one byte a task on the caller's stack, BCIR_TENSOR_SCAN_TASKS of them; a job past the bound scanned after it on the pool); the RMSNorm answers for its input rows through its output, the SwiGLU product for its gate and up through the product, the attention for its queries, values and probabilities through its context and reads its keys itself (a key whose scores are all -inf weighs 0, so the softmax can hide it).
